data.name: FaqImportFormatsQuestion
data.value: How do I import accounts from different formats?

data.name: FaqImportFormatsIntro
data.value: Use an original, unencrypted export from the source app. Encrypted Aegis and 2FAS exports are rejected. The following minimal structures show the required fields:

data.name: FaqImportFormatsAegisDescription
data.value: Export the vault from Aegis without encryption and select the resulting JSON file. OTP Harbor reads TOTP entries from db.entries. Encrypted vaults, HOTP entries, and unsupported TOTP parameters are rejected.

data.name: FaqImportFormatsTwoFasDescription
data.value: Create an unencrypted 2FAS backup and select the .2fas file. OTP Harbor reads TOTP accounts from services. Password-protected or encrypted backups and unsupported OTP parameters are rejected.

data.name: FaqImportFormatsOtpAuthDescription
data.value: Create a UTF-8 text file with one standard otpauth://totp URI per line. Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored. Every URI must contain an issuer and a valid Base32 secret and use supported SHA-1, six-digit TOTP parameters.
